Application Data.NAME: Videorama Media Boutique
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Media Lane, Suite 200, Los Angeles, CA 90001-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Videorama Media Boutique specializes in the retail sale of a wide variety of video and media products, including DVDs, Blu-rays, vinyl records, and digital media. The store also offers a curated selection of vintage and collectible items, along with gaming accessories. Our operations include in-store sales as well as an online platform for purchasing and renting media products. We are committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations and maintaining a secure environment for our customers. We have implemented loss prevention measures, fire safety systems, and regular inventory audits to mitigate risks associated with retail operations.
